classification_rule: Only COMPLETED_CLASSIFIABLE may carry classifiable=true and must bind preserved raw response bytes. Every other terminal state must carry classifiable=false and receives no numeric primary outcome.
attempt_rule: Replacement or retry attempts receive new attempt IDs and do not become new experimental units unless separately preregistered.
raw_output_rule: Successful/classifiable execution preserves exact request bytes and exact raw response bytes by SHA-256 binding. Provider errors preserve error-body bytes when present. Secrets and authorization headers are excluded.
change_rule: Any change to the bound schema or terminal-state semantics after this freeze requires an explicit thaw/re-freeze or separately identified successor before corpus-bearing execution.
non_claims: Schema conformance is not semantic correctness.
